slides.text: Schema markup won't get you cited by AI

slides.voiceover_text: Tip two: get listed in trade directories and build real mentions, not just backlinks.

geo_answer: Schema markup has minimal effect on whether AI engines cite a business; consistent business information and genuinely useful content build AI visibility far more effectively.
geo_takeaways: An analysis of 1,885 pages found schema markup had minimal correlation with AI citation rates.
AI engines extract meaning from natural language content much like a human reader, not from structured markup alone.
Schema still helps traditional search results, but it is not the lever that drives AI chatbot citations.
Consistent name, address, phone and service details across a website, Google Business Profile and directories matters more for AI discovery than technical markup.
